integrity: Uniform characteristic-two local-algebra proof; direct vertex computations are independent finite corroboration, not proof by extrapolation; no claim of independent audit or absolute historical novelty.
limitations: Only simple untwisted cubic honeycomb tori of side length three times a power of two with binary synchronous XOR; no primitive period spectrum or other sizes, fields or boundary twists.
title: Odd Jordan ladders and a sharp \(15/16\) last-step law for honeycomb parity dynamics
